questions.question: Why did the jujutsu college support Megumi instead of the Zenin Clan?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: When their parents died, Satoru Gojo stepped in and had the college support Megumi and his sister instead of Megumi heading to the Zenin Clan.

questions.question: Why did Megumi follow Yuji from Sugisawa Third High School?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi notices the presence of the cursed object on Yuji and decides to follow him.

questions.question: Why did Yuji and Megumi argue at the detention center?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: When one of the corpses turns out to be the son that a parent is worried about, Yuji wants to take him back, but Megumi tells him to leave it.

questions.question: How did Megumi figure out Noritoshi's ability during the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi figures that Noritoshi is manipulating his blood to increase his capabilities.

questions.question: What did Megumi do to protect his sister during the Death Painting investigation?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi check up on his sister and has guards to protect her

questions.question: What did Megumi summon to fight Haruta Shigemo during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi manages to summon Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga

questions.question: Why did Sukuna heal Megumi during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna then heals Megumi and says that he still needs him for something.

questions.question: Why did Megumi agree to be Remi's knight during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi relunctantly agrees to be her "knight" in the hopes she will lead him to the 100 point sorcerer Hiromi Higuruma

questions.question: How did Sukuna take over Megumi's body during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: He knocks out Hana and then transfers his curse energy into a finger then tears it off to feed it to Megumi, causing Sukuna to take possession of Megumi's body.

questions.question: Why did Sukuna desperately try to demoralize Megumi during the final battle?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna desperately attempted to demoralize Megumi, reminding him of everything that happened prior, his sisters death, his rejection of help, and the Shibuya deaths, all in order to maintain control over his body.
Megumi has died as of 2087, according to Yuji and Nobara.
